integrity: The geometric classification follows from explicit degree-stratum parametrizations and symplectic isotropic-plane incidence. Finite-field examples were checked by literal exterior multiplication and small symplectic enumeration. Independent mathematical validation and definitive priority confirmation have not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Algebraically closed fields of characteristic not two, reduced commuting-tuple variety, six exterior generators and lengths at least three; finite-field point counts only for odd q. No nonreduced-scheme or other-generator assertion.
title: Two rational components and exact finite-field counts for commuting tuples in the six-generator exterior algebra
